GROOV-E RETRO SERIES PERSONAL PORTABLE CD PLAYER WALKMAN - RED - GVPS110/RD

Barcode:  5060108293860        Product Code:  GVPS110/RD        RRP:  £24.99

 

Product Description

Take a step back in time with our stylish retro series portable CD player. Whilst it has a smart grown-up look it would make a really great kids CD player too and comes in 4 great colours.

 

Music on the move

This is the ideal small CD player for when you want music on the move. It comes with anti-skip protection to keep those sounds coming and has a cool retro style. Easy to carry and handle you can take it with you so you're never far from your favourite tunes.

 

Real Retro Style

It may look like a retro 80s icon but this compact CD player is right up to the minute with modern sound quality. It comes complete with matching earphones so you can get the very best from your CDs.

 

The technical bit

The retro personal CD player will support CD, CD-R and CD/RW formats (not MP3). It is powered by 2 x AA batteries or from the mains supply via a USB (not included). It is fitted with anti-skip protection, a repeat and Skip/Search function and has a 20 track programmable memory. There's an LCD display and even a battery level indicator so you won't run out of power unexpectedly.
